title: VIXEN RenderGraph witnesses need manual queue throttling and preflight overrides under host pressure
body: The live queue repeatedly blocked the required RenderGraph build/test behind CPU pressure and benchmark holds; the successful witnesses required --credits 1 plus UT_SKIP_KERNEL_ROOT=1 (and UT_SKIP_FRESHNESS=1 for tests). The VIXEN lane has no target-scoped admission profile that starts these short RenderGraph checks without manual overrides.
